coordinate_evidence.title: KIX10
coordinate_evidence.numeric_transform: None; numeric strings parsed and ordered longitude, latitude.

property_bridge.official_context: Digital Realty Q1 2024 supplement confirms a KIX10 Annex land acquisition, but does not itself crosswalk that name to KIX15.
property_bridge.secondary_corroboration_capture_note: Web text names KIX15 as KIX10 annex; direct raw capture returned HTTP 403, so it is corroborating research context and has no selected normalized-source hash.
property_bridge.limitation: Compiled references identify KIX15 as KIX10 Annex, but no primary record recovered that ties KIX15 to the KIX10 numbered property. Because the marketed KIX campus spans separate Ibaraki and Minoh properties, the proposed point is held pending a stronger property bridge.

visual_review.finding: Municipal unnamed Saito Yamabuki design and operator rendering share exterior massing, projecting floor bands, rooftop equipment and facade arrangement. This is corroborative visual inference only, not conclusive address or parcel evidence.

excluded_inferences: No assertion that KIX15 construction began on October 7.
No municipality centroid, Minoh facility point or office address substituted.
No use of the 220 MW portfolio aggregate as KIX15 capacity.
No claim of KIX15 permit issuance from unnamed municipal design review.
proposed_scope: Reported KIX10/KIX15 shared Ibaraki property, located using the official KIX10 point

proposed_locator_not_admitted.precision: KIX10 constituent-property marker at 5-8-1 Saito Yamabuki, used solely to locate the reported KIX10/KIX15 shared property. It does not locate the KIX15 building, its parcel boundary, the whole connected KIX campus, or active work extent.
proposed_locator_not_admitted.identity_review: The operator names KIX15 in Ibaraki within the Saito KIX campus. Baxtel explicitly identifies KIX15 as KIX10 Annex on shared lots 5-8-1 and 5-8-2; DC Byte also describes KIX15 as the KIX10 annex. Digital Realty independently records acquiring KIX10 Annex land in 2024 and publishes KIX10 at 5-8-1 with numeric coordinates. The exact KIX15-to-annex crosswalk remains compiled-reference evidence, not an operator cadastral assertion. Minoh KIX11/KIX12/KIX13 markers are not substituted.
proposed_locator_not_admitted.uncertainty_reason: The first-party point has no published datum realization, surveyed reference feature or numeric accuracy. Seven decimal places do not establish survey precision; KIX15 offset from this constituent-property marker is not quantified.

structural_certification_review.finding: Public details repeat the Tokyo applicant address and provide no public certificate drawing or cadastral location. Ten current Osaka environmental-plan index pages for fiscal 2024 and 2025 contained no KIX15 or Digital Osaka entry.
